name: manual_4bfe9c
claim: Never put a Mac LM Studio model in any automatic fallback chain alongside Ollama on the same Mac, even as the last entry: a fallback switches on its own exactly when the first model fails or times out, which for Ollama means overload, and it would then load a second large model on the same machine. That is the concurrent-load situation that once caused an overheat and forced shutdown, and the closed invariant is to never run both engines under load. Define the Mac LM Studio provider as a manual choice only, disabled and absent from openclaw.json and from every fallbacks list; keep its ready-to-use definition in a local reference snippet. Restoring a provider from an old config must check each agent's fallbacks for same-host engines, and a side agent's warning of this kind is verified against the invariant before it is overruled or accepted.

decisions.notes: Operator ruling 2026-11-25 after a side agent's warning during the OpenClaw staged restore; overrides the earlier choice to restore Mac LM Studio as a last-resort fallback.
